source.title: ONB1 – AI Onboarding Interview Question Bank v1.1 (DRAFT 2026-10-11)

conventions.option_ids: Option id = the number shown in the doc. Options marked (non-ordinal) in the doc have ordinal=false and are excluded from option_gte/option_lte.
conventions.followup_goal_and_required: The doc does not state goal/required for follow-up questions; per the appendix example, follow-ups are required=true and carry the goal of the question whose answer triggers them.
conventions.child_rule_ids: Depth-2 branch rules are named <parent rule id> + "a" (appendix convention, e.g. GEN-R1a).
conventions.swap_ins: A swap-in inherits the slot, slot_class and drop_priority of the generic question it replaces.

goals.goal: Contact details and best time to reach them

industries.name: Restaurants, bars and cafés
industries.why: Heavy phone and DM traffic (reservations, catering, events), shift scheduling, inventory and ordering, reviews. Lots of repetitive guest communication that AI can answer or route.

industries.name: Professional services (law, accounting/tax/bookkeeping, consulting)
industries.why: Email-heavy, document-heavy work: intake, chasing client documents, drafting routine letters, summarizing long files, seasonal crunch. High-value staff time and clear ROI.

industries.name: Home services and trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, landscaping, etc.)
industries.why: Missed calls are lost revenue. After-hours lead capture, booking and dispatch, estimate follow-up and invoicing are all very automatable.

industries.name: Medical and dental clinics
industries.why: Front-desk phone volume, scheduling and no-shows, intake paperwork, insurance verification, faxes and referrals. Large admin load per provider. (Extra privacy guardrails apply, see §5.)
industries.free_text_notice: Please describe how things work. No patient names or health details.

questions.text: First, what kind of business do you run?

detail_field.label: Want to add a few words? (e.g., 'family dental practice', 'HVAC and plumbing', 'neighborhood bistro')

options.label: Other professional services (consulting, agency, financial advice)

questions.text: What eats up the most time for you or your team right now? Pick up to two.

comment_field.label: Anything else we should know about it?

options.label: Data entry and copying info between tools
Reporting / knowing how the business is doing

questions.text: How many locations do you operate from? Count offices, shops, restaurants or clinics. If you work from one place or from home, that's 1.
About how many people work in the business, including you?
Which tools does your team use day to day? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Industry software (POS, practice management, field service, etc.)
Project or task tools (Asana, Monday, Trello, etc.)

questions.text: Picture 90 days from now and things went really well. What's different? (For example: 'I'm not answering email at night' or 'we never miss a lead.')
On a typical weekday, about how many emails land in your team's main inbox(es) that someone has to read or answer?
Roughly what's your annual revenue? A ballpark is fine, and you can skip this one.
Which roles do you have on the team? Pick all that apply.
Last one! How can we reach you, and when's a good time?
What eats up the most time running the restaurant right now? Pick up to two.
About how many people work across your restaurant(s), front and back of house combined?
Which tools do you use to run the restaurant? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Reservations or waitlist (OpenTable, Resy, Tock, etc.)
Inventory or invoice tools (MarginEdge, xtraCHEF, etc.)

questions.text: On a typical day, about how many guest messages come in across phone, email, your website and social DMs? (Reservations, catering, events, questions.)
Which roles do you have? Pick all that apply.
What eats up the most time at the firm right now? Pick up to two. (Please don't include client names or case details.)

options.label: Chasing clients for documents and info

questions.text: How many people are on the team in total, and roughly how many are billable professionals (attorneys, CPAs, consultants)?
Which tools does the firm use day to day? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Practice management (Clio, MyCase, PracticePanther, Karbon, TaxDome, Canopy, etc.)
Accounting or tax software (QuickBooks, Xero, Drake, Lacerte, UltraTax, etc.)
Document storage (SharePoint, Google Drive, Dropbox, NetDocuments, etc.)

questions.text: On a typical weekday, about how many emails does each professional on your team get?
Which roles do you have? Pick all that apply.
What eats up the most time right now? Pick up to two.

options.label: Following up on quotes and estimates

questions.text: How many techs or crew members are out in the field on a typical day? And how many people work in the office?
Which tools do you use to run jobs and the office? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Field service software (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, Workiz, etc.)
Lead sites (Angi, Thumbtack, Yelp, Google Local Services)

questions.text: On a typical weekday, about how many calls, texts, emails and web leads come in?
Who answers calls and books jobs today? Pick all that apply.
What eats up the most time at the practice right now? Pick up to two.
How many providers see patients (doctors, dentists, hygienists, therapists, NPs/PAs), and how many support staff do you have?
Which systems does the practice use? Pick all that apply.

options.label: EHR/EMR or practice management (Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, etc.)
Patient reminders or texting (Weave, RevenueWell, Solutionreach, etc.)
Online booking (Zocdoc, NexHealth, our website, etc.)

questions.text: On a typical day, about how many calls, texts and emails does your front desk handle?
Which roles keep the front office running? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Outsourced call center or answering service

questions.text: Which kinds of email take the most time?
How does your team feel about trying new tools?

options.label: Prefer as little change as possible

questions.text: When do calls and messages pile up the most?
What happens to calls nobody can pick up?
About how many catering or private-event inquiries do you get in a month?
Walk us through how an inquiry turns into a booked event today.
How do you build and share the staff schedule today?
How do you count inventory and place orders today?

options.label: The chef handles it by feel

questions.text: How do clients send you documents today?
About how many hours a week does the team spend chasing missing documents?
About how many new-client inquiries do you get in a month?
What happens between first contact and a signed engagement today?
Which months are busiest, and do you bring on extra help?
Where do client matters and deadlines live today?
Roughly what share of calls go unanswered, especially after hours?
What happens to calls after hours today?
About how many estimates do you send in a month?
How do you follow up on estimates that haven't been accepted?
How long does it usually take to get paid after a job is done?
How do techs get their schedule and job details each day?
About how many jobs do you schedule on a typical day?
Roughly what share of appointments end up as no-shows or late cancellations?
How do you remind patients about appointments today?
When do the phones get busiest?
What happens when every line is busy?
About how many insurance verifications or prior authorizations does your team handle each week?
How do new patients fill out intake forms today?
About how many faxes or referral documents come in on a typical day?
